international.title: Mamdani and Trump agree to delay on food stamp rules that put benefit at risk for millions
international.summary: New York City mayor says deal will allow bodegas and convenience stores across the country more time to comply Zohran Mamdani, the New York City mayor, has struck a deal with Donald Trump to secure a 90-day delay on new rules for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (Snap), so that bodegas and corner stores across the country have time to comply. The extension, Mamdani said, starts Friday as a result of conversations he had with Trump and Brooke Rollins, the agriculture secretary. Continue reading...
